lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to go up a mountain in the Abarim range, see the land, and then be gathered to his people.
The LORD says Moses and Aaron rebelled against His command at the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Moses asks the LORD to appoint a man over the congregation so it will not be like sheep without a shepherd.
The LORD tells Moses to lay his hands on Joshua son of Nun and commission him before Eleazar and the congregation.
Eleazar the priest will seek counsel for Joshua by the Urim, and Moses commissions Joshua before Aaron and the whole congregation.
